title: fix(studio): author panels speak the author's words; zh names label 显示名
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8QXYw5fBR8gQmfSEg5SfMPd)_

Fixes #36746
Fixes #36749

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- Studio 作者在中文界面里看到的都是业务话：查找关系选对象时提示「选择对象…」并带下拉箭头，提示里写对象的中文名；保存后的提醒只显示给作者看的那句话；通知节点的说明不再出现「别名」和英文默认值；对象设置页不再在每个标题旁并列英文键名，鼠标悬停才显示；「标签」「显示名称」统一叫「显示名」。
- 来自你 11-23 的 Studio 评审（9 张卡里的两张文案卡），给搭建应用的人减少技术词。
- 只改界面文字和提示的显示方式，不改任何保存的数据或接口；出错最多是某句提示措辞不对，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

**#36746 r08 — Lookup 「关联对象」.**
- `designer.field.objectNamePlaceholder` is now a sentence (`Select object…` / `选择对象…`) instead of `object_name`; the roll-up child-object picker reads the same key.
- `ObjectPicker` draws a chevron (`object-picker-chevron`, decorative, `pointer-events-none`) and reserves its room (`pr-7`); the input is monospace only while it shows a machine name, never for the placeholder. Applies to every `ObjectPicker` host.
- `LookupConfigFields` and `RelatedListFields` resolve `{ref}` to the target's catalog label through a new module-private `useObjectLabel` (reads `useObjectCatalog`, the read the picker beside it already makes). The hard-coded English `'related'` fallback is gone.
- Before a target is set, the "every record is selectable" line says `designer.field.lookup.setTargetFirst` instead, and the related-list help is not drawn. `designer.field.relatedList.parentFallback` lost its only reader and is deleted from en and zh.

**#36746 r09 — the advisory toast head.** `saveAdvisoryToast.formatFinding`: a finding with a `userMessage` renders that sentence alone. `[rule] where` stays on the developer face (a finding with no `userMessage`: `[rule] where — message hint`, unchanged).

**#36746 r10 — Notify node.** The en base table (`flow-node-config.ts`) and the zh overlay (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, the only locale overlay) are rewritten in the author's words: no `subject`/`body` aliases, no `"notify"` default, no `info | warning | critical`, no "user id" / "object name". The topic row reads `Category` / `通知类别` (it is the notification kind recipients switch on or off in their notification settings) and loses its `notify` placeholder; zh severity options read 一般 / 警告 / 紧急. The served-only rows `actorId` and `payload` are rewritten in the zh overlay.

**#36746 r11 — setting keys.** Per the 15:23Z ruling, the key stays off the panel at rest and is the title's hover text. `ObjectSettingsPanel`'s `SettingKey` chip is replaced by `SettingKeyHover`, a wrapper around the title carrying `title={key}` (outside the `<label>`, so each control is still named by its title alone); the object inspector's `split.renderKey` (a ReactNode drawn beside the title) becomes `split.keysOnHover: boolean`, and its `RowTitle`/`KeyedTextField` put the key(s) on the same kind of wrapper (`icon · color` share one row). The file header cites this card as superseding #36512's small print.

**#36749 — zh 「显示名」.** Every Studio zh row that names an item's `label` says 显示名. Rows changed (studio `zh.ts`):

| Key | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `engine.studio.data.addFieldNeedsLabel` | 请先填写标签。 | 请先填写显示名。 |
| `engine.studio.data.addFieldApiNameNotDerived` | 标签里没有… | 显示名里没有… |
| `perm.field.label` | 标签 | 显示名 |
| `perm.basics.editHint` | 编辑名称 / 标签 | 编辑名称 / 显示名 |
| `designer.field.basePatchOnly.optionLabels` | 选项标签 | 选项显示名 |
| `engine.inspector.flowNode.sourceLabel` | 原文标签：… | 原文显示名：… |
| `engine.inspector.flowNode.label` | 标签 | 显示名 |
| `engine.studio.if.pageProps.label` | 标签 | 显示名 |
| `engine.studio.auto.newSimilar.label` | 新的标签 | 新的显示名 |
| `engine.studio.auto.newSimilar.bodyPair` / `bodyHere` | 以新的机器名和标签… | 以新的机器名和显示名… |
| `engine.actionPreview.empty` | 设置名称和标签… | 设置名称和显示名… |
| `engine.agentPreview.empty` | 填写标签、角色和指令 | 填写显示名、角色和指令 |
| `engine.picklistPreview.colLabel` | 标签 | 显示名 |
| `engine.studio.rules.label` | 标签（可选） | 显示名（可选） |
| `engine.studio.nav.label` | 标签 | 显示名 |
| `engine.list.search` | 搜索名称、标签或描述… | 搜索名称、显示名或描述… |
| `engine.list.col.label` | 标签 | 显示名 |
| `engine.sharingRule.clone.label` | 新标签 | 新的显示名 |
| `engine.create.nameNotDerived` | …显示名称… | …显示名… |
| `engine.packages.create.name` | 显示名称 | 显示名 |
| `engine.packages.idRule.derived` / `notDerived` | …显示名称… | …显示名… |
| `engine.datasource.label` | 显示名称 | 显示名 |
| `engine.studio.createItem.notDerived` / `needLabel` | …显示名称… | …显示名… |

Rows deliberately left as they are, because 标签 there is another word:
- tabs: `perm.tabs.*`, `engine.inspector.appNav.urlTarget*`, `engine.inspector.pageBlock.option.formType.tabbed`, `…page:tabs.items` / `add.page:tabs.items`, `engine.form.filterModeTabs`, `engine.form.tabLabel`, `engine.form.moveTab*` / `removeTab` / `bindObjectForTabRules`, `engine.pageBlockCanvas.type.pageTabs`, and every 「…标签页…」 sentence;
- the `tags` field type and tag lists: `engine.fieldType.tags`, `engine.fieldTypeDesc.tags`, `engine.validationPreview.tags`, `engine.bookPreview.tagTitle`;
- the flow edge's branch label: `engine.inspector.flowEdge.label`, `engine.inspector.flowEdge.hint`, and the flow-preview sentence about an edge's branch label;
- the status chip next to a record name: `engine.studio.settings.stageField`; the related-list tab count: `designer.field.relatedList.filterHelp`; HTML tags: `engine.studio.interfaces.create.pageKindHtmlHint`;
- page-block item labels (the card's `zh:762–908` range, checked one by one): `…object-metric.label`, `…page:tabs.items.label`, `…page:accordion.items.label`, `…record:details.sections.label`, `…record:path.stages.label`. Each is the caption drawn on a tab, panel, section or stage inside one block, not an item's display name; renaming them would make the tabs block read 「标签页 › 显示名」 next to its own 「标签页」.
- `designer.field.lookup.referenceNameVisible` (不可读时显示名称) is "show the name", a verb phrase, not the noun.

Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

- New `ObjectFieldInspector.lookupWording-36746.test.tsx`: the placeholder in zh and en, prose type, chevron; with no target, `setTargetFirst` shows and neither hint (no `related`, no 父对象, no related-list help); with a target, both hints name it by its catalog label (`线索`), never the API name `crm_lead`.
- `saveAdvisoryToast.test.ts` and `AdapterProvider.advisoryUserMessage-32657.test.tsx`: with a `userMessage` the line is that sentence alone, without `[rule]` or `where`; the developer-face CONTROL cases are unchanged.
- New `flow-node-config.notifyWording-36746.test.ts`: the Notify rows in en and zh carry none of the developer wordings named on the card; the topic row is a category with no literal default; zh severity options read as words.
- `ObjectSettingsPanel.businessWording-36512.test.tsx`: the chip cases are rewritten. Every key the tab writes is a title's hover text, outside any `<label>`, and none is drawn as text; a switch's title still flips it; the whole-panel host has no key hover text.
- New `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-zh-label-word-36749.test.ts`: the add-field hints say 显示名; each changed row says 显示名, never 标签 (outside 标签页) or 显示名称.
- Copy follow-ons: `notify-node.dogfood` and `FlowNodeInspector.requiredMarkers-10948` read `Category`; the two `PackageFormDialog` suites read 显示名. The four edited suites now import `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` at module top (`check:test-source-alias`).

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- 394 test files around the change (every app-shell suite named ObjectFieldInspector / ObjectPicker / ObjectDefaultInspector / ObjectSettingsPanel / flow-node-config / FlowNodeInspector / notify / advisory / PackageFormDialog / StudioDesignSurface / AddFieldPopover, plus all of `packages/i18n/`): `Test Files 394 passed (394)`, `Tests 4572 passed | 14 skipped`.
- The four suites edited after that run: `Test Files 4 passed`, `Tests 40 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0.
- `check:test-source-alias`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations): exit 0.
- The rest of the `dispatch-gates --commands` list and the full suites are CI's: read from this PR's check-runs.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- r10, en online face: against a running engine the Notify rows' English label and help come from the engine-published descriptor (`service-automation` `notify-node.ts` `configSchema`), which keeps its developer descriptions. This PR changes the en base table (offline) and the zh overlay (applied on top of the served rows); rewording the descriptor is a producer change, left out here as the card scopes it to the base table and overlays.
- r10: Topic, Triggering user and Payload were not moved behind the Advanced fold (optional on the card). The flow field table has no per-row fold; moving a row there would mean dropping it from the table, which `mergeServerFlowFields` would then not bring back online.
- r09: naming objects and permission sets by label inside the sentence stays out of scope (review F3, producer side, #32654).

## Verification

Browser, zh-CN, showcase backend plus a new Studio package 「Customer Visits」 with object 回访记录, on `dcb0e8f0`. Screenshots are attached in the project thread (GitHub's image store takes browser uploads only):

- r08: a new Lookup field 「关联客户」 with no target: the picker reads 「选择对象…」 in prose type with a chevron; 显示字段 / 描述字段 / 可选记录范围 say 「请先设置目标对象」; no related-list help line. After picking 联系人: 「未设筛选 — 所有 联系人 记录均可选。」 and 「在 联系人 记录页上与其他关联记录一起列出。」 (read from the DOM).
- r11: object 设置 tab: no key chip anywhere (`code` elements: 0); 19 titles carry their key as `title` (`label`, `pluralLabel`, `icon · color`, `description`, `sharingModel`, `nameField`, `stageField`, `highlightFields`, `relatedLists`, seven `enable.*`, `name`, `access.default`, `requiredPermissions`). A native tooltip is not drawn in a headless screenshot, so the hover is evidenced by the attribute, not a frame.
- r10: showcase flow 「Notify Assignee on Task Assignment」, Notify node: 标题 「收件人看到的通知标题。必填。」, 内容 「显示在标题下方的正文。」, 渠道 「通知送达的地方：站内信、邮件或推送。不填时只发站内信。」, 通知类别, 级别 一般, 来源对象, 触发用户 rows as rewritten; the node's own label row reads 显示名.
- #36749: the add-field popover reads 显示名 with 「请先填写显示名。」; 新建对象 says 「请先填写显示名」; 新建软件包 labels its name 显示名.
- r09 was not driven in the browser (it needs a save that returns an advisory with a producer sentence); the two toast suites pin it.

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` and `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`: the `split.keysOnHover` contract change (riskiest: a key on the wrapper, never on the label).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`: `useObjectLabel` and the two hints' gating.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/saveAdvisoryToast.ts`: `formatFinding`.

Two-minute check: in a zh-CN Studio, open an object's 设置 tab: no English key beside any title; hover a title and its key appears.
